rule_or_pattern: Drop every line with width_ratio > 0.8 on ANY page of this book (all pages are two-column; real column lines have width_ratio ~0.3-0.5). The page column detector reports 1 column on p002/p003/p004/p009, so the D:column_crossing/merge flags and the pool gutter rule miss those merged lines.
notes: 1880 parliament minutes, two columns throughout. Lines inside one column (width ~0.48: 1-3, 8, 13, 14, 17-19) read correctly. Every full-width crop (width 0.94-0.99) joins half-lines from both columns across the gutter; half of the random sample (4-7, 9, 11, 12, 15, 16) is of this kind but unflagged because the page was counted as single-column, and some of these labels drop part of the crop (9, 15, 16, 22 'νὰ τὸ ἀρνηθῆτε' for a whole merged line).
